Cup Lids & Sealing Films — Matched to Every Caliber

One-stop lid matching: every cup we sell ships with the right lid or sealing film, so store operations stay simple and leak complaints stay at zero. Full range of thermoformed PET lids and heavy-duty injection lids, plus sealing film by the roll.

Key Features

  • PET lids: flat 2.2g, dome, sipper, panda, half-round dessert
  • Injection lids: single/double-hole, U-mouth, phone-holder
  • Calibers 90 / 92 (square) / 95 / 98 / 119 mm
  • Strawless / sipper options for plastic-reduction markets
  • PP & PET sealing film rolls, custom printable
  • Straws, carriers and sleeves available

A Lid For Every Serving Style

The lid is where customer experience and brand detail meet. We carry lightweight PET lids for iced drinks (flat, dome, sipper/strawless, panda, brick and half-round dessert domes) and rigid injection lids for premium and hot service (single-hole, double-hole, U-mouth, split and even a phone-holder lid). All lids are matched by exact rim diameter — 90, 92 (square), 95, 98 and 119mm — and we also supply PP/PET sealing film, custom-printed with your brand, for cup-sealing machines.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I know which lid fits my cup?

Match by rim diameter. Measure the outer rim of your cup (90, 92, 95, 98 or 119mm) or send us your cup sample — we confirm fit before production.

Do you have strawless / sipper lids?

Yes. Our sipper and half-open lids let customers drink without a straw — increasingly required in plastic-reduction markets like the EU and parts of the US.

Can sealing film be custom printed?

Yes, we print your logo and artwork on PP and PET sealing film rolls. MOQ applies per design; send artwork for a quote.
